name: spellwarden
description: The Spellwarden scanner plugin: scan agent skills, plugins and MCP servers before you install them.

plugins.name: spellwarden
plugins.description: Scans agent skills, plugins, marketplaces and MCP servers with the open-source Spellwarden scanner on your machine before you install them, and reports what it found so you can decide.

plugins.name: spellwarden-guard
plugins.description: Asks you to confirm before Claude itself installs a plugin, marketplace, skill or MCP server, or edits a .mcp.json file, and suggests a Spellwarden scan first. Pairs with the spellwarden plugin.
